title: Consultant Connect Ltd v NHS Bath and North East Somerset
description: The contracting authority (NHS) misused an existing framework agreement to run a single-supplier 'mini-competition' without genuine competition. Consultant Connect Ltd challenged the award, arguing that this process did not comply with the terms of the framework agreement or the Public Contracts Regulations 2015 requirements for fairness and transparency.
contracting_authority_name: NHS Bath and North East Somerset, Swindon and Wiltshire Integrated Care Board
